gatewaySetup.pageDesc: Kun opens an OpenAI-, Anthropic- and Gemini-compatible address on this computer, so coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex can use the models you set up in Kun.
gatewaySetup.title: Local gateway
gatewaySetup.protocols: OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini compatible, this computer only
gatewaySetup.summaryOff: Turn it on to let coding agents and tools on this computer use Kun's models through this address.
gatewaySetup.guideTitle: Three steps to give your agents Kun's models
gatewaySetup.guideDesc: After these steps, Claude Code, Codex and others call the models you set up under Model providers through the local gateway. This card goes away once all three are done.
gatewaySetup.stepOnDesc: Serves at {{address}} and creates an access key automatically. Only this computer can reach it.
gatewaySetup.stepOnDone: On. It accepts only requests from this computer that carry a key.
gatewaySetup.stepModelsDesc: The quickest way is to share your provider models. Create a routed model when you want one fixed name or automatic failover for a group of models.
gatewaySetup.stepModelsSharing: Sharing is on; waiting for Kun Runtime to list the models. You can also create a routed model.
gatewaySetup.stepAgentsDesc: Below, pick a model for an agent and turn on its switch. Kun changes only the settings it owns and restores them when you turn the switch off.
gatewaySetup.manualDesc: Any tool that lets you set a base URL and an API key can go through Kun like this.

formatHints.chat: Chat Completions, the API most tools use; works with anything that takes an OpenAI base URL.
formatHints.responses: OpenAI Responses, used by newer tools such as Codex.
formatHints.anthropic: Anthropic Messages, used by tools such as Claude Code.
formatHints.gemini: Gemini API, used by tools such as Gemini CLI.

gatewaySetup.keyHint: Put it in {{env}}. The key only goes to your clipboard; it is never shown on screen.
gatewaySetup.modelHint: Use a routed model's public ID, or provider/model for a shared provider model.
gatewaySetup.noModels: The gateway has no models yet.
gatewaySetup.exampleHint: Replace {{placeholder}} with the key you copied above.
gatewaySetup.standaloneTitle: Generate a config for a standalone client
gatewaySetup.standaloneDesc: Leaves the agent's global settings alone: writes an isolated launch config into a folder you choose, with a key of its own.
gatewaySetup.routedModelsDesc: Give a group of targets one fixed public ID. Switch the provider behind it or fail over inside Kun without touching any agent's config.
gatewaySetup.publicIdHint: Agents and tools request the model by this ID.
gatewaySetup.identityDesc: Kun's own model picker lists routed models under this name.
gatewaySetup.masterKeyDesc: Tools you connect by hand use this key to reach the gateway. Agents connected under Connect each get a key of their own.
gatewaySetup.confirmRevokeKey: Revoke the shared key? Requests from tools that use it will be refused.
